title: llm-usage-metrics doctor report output (v1)
description: Envelope and payload for doctor --json output.

sources.description: One health row per selected source, plus the event store when enabled.

sourceResult.description: Health of one source or the event store.

id.description: Source id, event-store, or machine:<name> for a configured machine.

format.description: Storage format of the source; ssh for a machine.

status.description: Whether discovery ran (error: it failed). See state for whether usage was found.

state.description: Source rows only. found: files with readable usage; not_installed: no files in any searched path; unparseable: files whose newest entries yield no usage; error: discovery failed.

itemsFound.description: Files (or events for the store) discovered; rows whose discovery ran.

detail.description: Extra detail: why an unparseable source has no usage, or the event-store summary.

searchedPaths.description: Source rows only: directories or database files discovery searched.
